//: Composite indexes Firestore needs for the queries this backend runs.
Kept in version control so a deploy cannot succeed with a query that will
fail at runtime for want of an index.
History pagination orders messages by createdAt descending within one
conversation's subcollection. The single-field index Firestore creates
automatically covers that, so no composite entry is needed for it.
The idempotency lookup filters on clientMessageId and takes one result.
An equality filter on a single field is also automatic. The composite
below exists for the combination the backend uses when it needs the most
recent message from a given sender, which is not automatic.
